name: Terrordale
summary: Terrordale’s streets lie in ruin beneath restless dead, beside Plaguewood and Terrorweb Tunnel. In the northwestern Eastern Plaguelands, Scourge horrors and tormented spirits haunt what remains.

sections.title: A Haunted Haven on the Wood's Edge
sections.body: Terrordale fell to the Scourge with the rest of Lordaeron. Near Terrorweb Tunnel’s mouth, restless shades and wandering undead fill the ruined village streets. Plaguewood’s trees press against its rotting timber. A few eccentric residents still dare to stay. Augustus the Touched is a peculiar merchant, while Egan hunts ghosts and seeks to free the tortured spirits caught between worlds.

sections.title: Spiritual Disturbance and Exorcism
sections.body: Terrordale’s spirits remain in agony, bound to the earth by their tragic ends. Their anguish disturbs the spirit realm so deeply that the physical world buckles beneath it. Seasoned paladins come under the guidance of the Silver Hand and Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker. Through rites of judgment and sacrifice, they seek to banish the torment. The work tests their holy discipline.

faq.answer: Terrordale lies in the northwestern Eastern Plaguelands, a ruined hamlet west of Plaguewood and south of Terrorweb Tunnel. Scourge horrors and tormented ghosts overrun it.

faq.q: Who are the people still in the town?
faq.answer: Two eccentric figures linger among Terrordale’s ruins. Egan hunts ghosts and tries to pacify and free the trapped spirits. Augustus the Touched is a half-mad undead hermit and merchant, intent on recovering his old ledgers and possessions.

faq.q: What connects this town to the paladin trials?
faq.answer: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker sends paladins seeking to bond with their holy warhorse charger to Terrordale. They use an exorcism censer to banish the tormented spirits. The trial proves the spiritual resolve, judgment, and sacrifice required of an elite knight of the Light.

angles.text: As a paladin, you face a trial in Terrordale. Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker sends candidates for the charger steed into the ruined hamlet to exorcise its weeping spirits.
As a human, Terrordale’s broken houses recall the fall of northern Lordaeron. Common citizens’ spirits remain trapped in death in their own front yards.
